display_title: The Guy Who Kisses You Per Assignment
description:
Yoon Jiho is a quiet, unremarkable student who lives a low-profile life on campus — but he’s completely smitten with Ian, the vocalist of the indie band 'Maniacs'. While struggling through the grind of college life and finding escape in his fangirling, Jiho ends up being forced to take on the role of team leader for a group project. When he calls a team member who hasn’t shown up yet, he unexpectedly reaches none other than Ian himself! Ian, realizing Jiho harbors feelings for him that go beyond simple fandom, tries to use that affection to freeload on the project — but Jiho isn’t that easy to manipulate. Even after treating him to food and pleading, Jiho stands firm… until Ian suddenly grabs him and kisses him!

*“Even after that — still no?”*

Will Jiho give in and let Ian ride his coattails, or will he stand his ground?

---
